checks.name: Unique identities, assets, sources, counterpart links and retail contents resolve
Precise Ninco radii are retained and all five road families nest
Straight dimensions and nominal cross-sections remain independent
Circular lane lengths differ by 2 pi times configured lane spacing
Stored models preserve path endpoints and lane identities
Half-angle outer borders are not mistaken for full matching-road coverage
Unverified illustrations and accessory elevations cannot provide fit or lane lengths
Retail quantities, unknown kit contents and disputed border counts remain separate
Ninco road artwork uses its texture, with dashed markings confined to grid variants

limits: Nominal mathematical and catalogue consistency checks only. Unmeasured borders, special routes, connectors and accessory footprints remain unresolved.
